verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud has a first-party pricing calculator for a dedicated-cluster model. It explicitly has "no limits on records or operations", and its configurable options (High Availability, Search Delivery Network, GPU) suggest cluster/node-based pricing a founder could estimate up front. The self-hosted server is also free under GPL-3.0. However, the evidence never shows actual published per-node or per-hour rates, so the cost-predictability claim rests on the calculator's existence rather than visible prices. Missing for 10: actual published per-unit (node/RAM/hour) prices, worked cost examples, independent corroboration of pricing predictability.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing (searches, records, or nodes) lets me predict what search will cost before committing
